extension.description: Seren is a modular provider based, cloud service streaming software that is tightly interwoven with Trakt. Seren provides the freedom to view media from a single menu system from service providers of the users choosing. Please Note: This addon requires the use of a compatible cloud service.

extension.news:
Changelog 3.3.255 [FEATURE] MDBList: added Collection Movies, Collection Shows, and Dropped Shows menus (My Movies/My Shows), mirroring Simkl's status-bucket menus - live sync/collection and sync/dropped fetches, resolved via Trakt and rendered through the existing list pipeline, never written to mdblistSync.db. Dropped Shows has no movies-side equivalent - MDBList's API only supports dropped shows, not dropped movies.
Changelog 3.3.254 [CLEANUP] list_builder.py: removed an unused, never-invoked L1 list cache (_L1_CACHE/_l1_key/_l1_get/_l1_set/clear_l1_cache) - an orphaned duplicate of the real, active L1 list cache in trakt_sync/__init__.py (_LIST_CACHE/list_cache_get/list_cache_set), which remains untouched and is still what actually backs get_show_list/get_movie_list and the prefetch-next-page mechanism. No behavior change.
Changelog 3.3.249 [DOCS] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: no behavior change. 3.3.248's Simkl isolation recursion relies on sync/history being safe to re-post an already-succeeded item (unlike Trakt's additive play-log) - that claim was carried from a prior session without this session independently re-checking it. Now spec-confirmed directly (simkl.apib: "Already-completed items don't bump on subsequent POST /sync/history calls" absent allow_rewatch=yes, which this call never sets) and the code comment updated to cite it, instead of resting on the weaker not_found-awareness argument alone.
Changelog 3.3.248 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: MDBList and Simkl watched-movie pushes now isolate items individually when a batch's response can't be fully explained by its updated+not_found counts, instead of leaving the whole batch/chunk unresolved. Closes a gap in the existing not_found-based isolation (which already handled the common case of a single bad id cleanly) for this rarer, ambiguous-response case. Trakt's push is unchanged - its watch-history is an additive log, not safely retryable per item.
Changelog 3.3.246 [FIX] MDBList watched-status sync: pagination was silently capped at page 1 (a prior fix assumed a cursor field that doesn't exist in MDBList's API), so most accounts only ever had their first ~100 watched episodes reflected locally and everything past that got wiped as "unwatched" on every sync. Also fixed a nesting bug that made watched movies always read as empty, and movies are now reset/repopulated from MDBList's real remote state the same way episodes already were, so a movie unmarked or removed directly on MDBList's site now correctly clears locally too instead of staying stuck. [FIX] Simkl sync: movies/shows removed from Simkl's tracked lists (or moved out of Completed/Watching) directly on Simkl's own site were never removed from Seren's local cache, since Simkl's activity timestamps can't surface removals by themselves. Now detected by diffing against a fresh id list on every relevant activity change, live-verified against a real account with zero false-positive removals. [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7): a watched-status push to Trakt or MDBList that actually failed (no response, or an error) was still being written to Seren's own local view as if it had succeeded, so a failed push looked successful until a later full sync quietly reverted it. Local writes now only happen after the remote push is confirmed. [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: Simkl watched-movie pushes are now aware of individual not_found items instead of all-or-nothing (matching MDBList's existing handling), and MDBList watched-episode pushes are now sent in smaller batches, so one bad item can no longer block an entire batch. [FIX] Trakt hidden-items lists: "Hide from Recommendations" and "Hide from Calendar" (TV Shows) and "Hide from Progress/Watched" (Movies) were being saved and checked under the wrong media-type key, so items hidden from these specific lists could silently fail to actually stay hidden. All 7 hide-list call sites now use a consistent key. [FIX] MDBList "Remove from List": a remove that MDBList's API silently rejected (item not on that list) still showed a success notification and refreshed the view as if it had worked. Now checks the response the same way "Add to List" already did and shows an accurate notification either way.
Changelog 3.3.245 [FIX] "My Movies"/"My TV Shows" home-screen entries now correctly appear for a Simkl-only setup - the visibility check only ever tested for Trakt or MDBList (a leftover from before Simkl existed), so a user with only Simkl enabled could never reach either menu at all, even though the Simkl-sourced content inside them (Simkl - In Progress/Recently Watched) already rendered fine once reached another way. Now checks all three services, matching the same OR-gate already used correctly by Sync Tools' visibility check elsewhere in this file.
Changelog 3.3.244 [FIX] "Merge - In Progress"/"Merge - Recently Watched" (Movies and Shows) now correctly appear for any 2 of the 3 supported services (Trakt, MDBList, Simkl) - previously the menu entries only appeared when Trakt and MDBList were both active (a leftover from before Simkl existed), so a Trakt+Simkl or MDBList+Simkl setup with no Trakt never saw them at all even though there was real data to merge. Each source's fetch inside the merge is now also individually gated the same way Simkl's already was, so disabling one service no longer leaves its stale synced data mixed into the merged list.
Changelog 3.3.243 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: hardened progress-sync against a possible crash - if Trakt ever returned a non-numeric progress value for one in-progress item, the rounding added in 3.3.242 would have raised an unhandled error and skipped every remaining item in that sync cycle silently. Never observed in practice, but now skips just that one item safely instead, same as how a missing progress value was already handled. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.242 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: progress-sync pushes to MDBList were being rejected for most in-progress items - MDBList only accepts a progress percentage with up to 5 total digits, but Trakt's raw values commonly have more (e.g. 37.7697), so the majority of pushes were silently failing validation. Now rounds to 2 decimal places before sending, which always fits. Also added a log line for the (much rarer) case a push to MDBList or Simkl is rejected for any other reason, so future issues like this are visible in the log instead of silent. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.241 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: progress-sync from Trakt (mirroring playback progress set on other Trakt-connected devices/apps into MDBList/Simkl) was silently broken for the same underlying reason as 3.3.240's watchlist fix, but the other way around - this code already expected the original response shape, it was just being fed the addon's transformed shape by mistake, so it silently did nothing every cycle. Fixed to read the original shape directly. Does not affect Seren's own built-in playback tracking, which was never affected by this. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.240 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: Trakt watchlist syncing was silently broken - the addon's Trakt API layer transforms every response into a different shape before handing it back, and the watchlist-read code was written for the original untransformed shape, so it always read nothing and Trakt's side of the watchlist bridge never contributed anything. Fixed the field read to match the shape the addon's Trakt layer actually returns. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.239 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: Trakt watchlist reads now paginate properly too - Trakt applies a default page size of 100 to this endpoint even when no paging is requested, and silently caps it at 250 if a larger page size is asked for, so a Trakt watchlist over 100 items would only ever show its first page to the addon, same failure as 3.3.238's MDBList side just with a lower threshold. Also audited the progress-sync read (sync/playback) and confirmed it returns everything unpaginated by default, so it did not need this fix. No practical effect on smaller watchlists. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.238 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: MDBList watchlist reads now paginate properly, same fix as 3.3.237's collection read - MDBList silently caps its watchlist page size at 1000 regardless of what's requested, so an account with a watchlist over 1000 items would only ever see the first page, making the addon think everything past it was missing from MDBList. No practical effect on smaller watchlists. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.237 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: MDBList collection reads now paginate properly (offset/limit loop) instead of only reading page 1, fixing a gap where hundreds of cascaded episode records could push real movie/show entries out of view and make the addon think MDBList's collection was missing items it actually has. Watchlist pushes to MDBList now identify and stop retrying individual permanently-invalid items instead of silently retrying the same small batch forever, matching the collection/watched-history fix pattern; the common case (everything succeeds) is unaffected and costs no extra API calls. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.236 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: 13 shows had synced to Trakt's Collection but silently never reached MDBList, because once an item enters a service's synced snapshot it isn't re-checked against other targets on later runs. One-time data correction re-queues them for push; this was a one-off drift, not addressed structurally (a full recurrence-proof fix needs new tracking machinery, deferred). MDBList pushes for Collection and Watchlist are now also sent in smaller batches, matching the watched-history fix in 3.3.235, so a single bad item can no longer block an entire batch. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.235 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync to MDBList: a single item MDBList's catalog didn't recognize was enough to make Seren treat an entire watched-movies batch as failed and silently retry the whole thing forever, even though the rest of the batch had actually succeeded. Pushes to MDBList are now sent in smaller batches and read the response's own per-item results, so real successes are kept; a permanently-unrecognized item is now logged and not retried again instead of blocking everything behind it. No user-facing change; fixes a live-testing find in the background bridge added in 3.3.233/3.3.234.
Changelog 3.3.234 [FIX] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7) bridge sync: pushes to Trakt/MDBList/Simkl are now batched per run instead of one API call per item, and success is now verified against the actual API response instead of assumed - a failed push is retried next cycle instead of being silently marked done. No user-facing change; hardens the background bridge added in 3.3.233 before first real-world use.
Changelog 3.3.233 [NEW] Cross-Service Sync (Phase 7): Trakt, MDBList, and Simkl now mirror each other automatically. Marking watched/unwatched, rating, adding to watchlist/collection, etc. from any one service's context menu instantly pushes to the others, and a background bridge reconciles anything changed directly on a service's own website every ~15 minutes - all without requiring Trakt to be connected. New "Cross-Service Sync" toggle under Watch Accounts (on by default). See Simkl_Implementation_Plan.md for full domain coverage and documented exclusions.
Changelog 3.3.232 [NEW] Merge - In Progress / Merge - Recently Watched menus now fold in Simkl as a third source alongside Trakt and MDBList, deduplicated by most-recent timestamp. Only applies if Simkl is connected and enabled - no change for Trakt/MDBList-only users.
Changelog 3.3.231 [FIX] Internal cleanup: removed unused MDBList/Simkl sync routes left over from the Sync Tools gateway consolidation. No user-facing change.
Changelog 3.3.230 [NEW] Sync Tools menu now covers Trakt, MDBList, and Simkl together: Clear last sync time and Force a sync both fan out to all three configured services from one menu; Rebuild Database stays Trakt-only (MDBList/Simkl don't support a safe rebuild). [NEW] Clear last sync time now shows a confirmation notification for all three services. [NEW] Added a "Clear Cache Tool" submenu under Tools, consolidating Clear All Cache, Clear Local Torrent Cache, Clear Debrid Hash Cache, Clear Search History, Provider Performance Stats, Clear Provider Stats, and Re-enable All Providers out of the flat Tools list.
Changelog 3.3.229 [NEW] Simkl now has dedicated menus - "Simkl - Recently Watched" and "Simkl - In Progress" under Movies and TV Shows, matching Trakt/MDBList's own menus. [NEW] Added a full "Simkl Manager" context menu entry: mark watched/unwatched, rate 1-10, set watchlist status (Watching/Plan to Watch/On Hold/Dropped/Completed), and clear playback progress. [FIX] The "Simkl Manager" context menu item (visible since the initial Simkl release) now actually opens instead of doing nothing.
Changelog 3.3.228 [FIX] Simkl background sync now correctly retries a domain (movies/shows/playback) after a transient failure on the next cycle, instead of the retry potentially being silently delayed until an unrelated Simkl activity occurred.
Changelog 3.3.227 [NEW] Simkl now periodically syncs watched movies/shows and in-progress playback in the background, matching Trakt/MDBList's sync cadence, and re-syncs automatically if you switch Simkl accounts. This release covers background sync only - dedicated Simkl menus (Recently Watched, In Progress, etc.) are still in progress.
Changelog 3.3.226 [NEW] Simkl now scrobbles real-time playback (start/pause/stop) alongside Trakt and MDBList, gated by its own "Enable Simkl Scrobbling" setting. Watched items are marked on your Simkl account immediately; local watched-status display and full account sync are still in progress.
Changelog 3.3.225 [NEW] Added Simkl account authorization (Watch Accounts settings) - PIN-based login/logout matching Trakt's flow. This release covers login/logout only; scrobbling, sync, and dedicated Simkl menus are still in progress.
Changelog 3.3.224 [FIX] Hiding a show/movie from Progress (or a show from Recommendations/the Recent Episodes calendar) never actually excluded it anywhere - a bug in the shared "hidden items" lookup silently made every hide a no-op. Affected On Deck Movies/Shows, New Shows, and Recent Episodes; hiding an item now correctly removes it everywhere it applies. [NEW] "MDBList - In Progress Episodes" and "Merge - In-Progress" now respect "Hide from Progress" too, matching Trakt's On Deck. [NEW] MDBList now re-syncs periodically in the background alongside Trakt, instead of only once right after connecting your account. [FIX] MDBList background sync no longer runs while "Enable MDBList" is switched off. [FIX] Renaming, changing privacy, or deleting a static MDBList list now refreshes the screen immediately, matching the existing dynamic-list behaviour.
Changelog 3.3.215 [NEW] Added "MDBList - My Movie Lists"/"MDBList - My Show Lists" entries (My Movies/My Shows menus, MDBList section), mirroring "Trakt - My Movie/Show Lists" for browsing your own MDBList-hosted lists. Each page is fetched live and resolved to Trakt objects the same way other MDBList menus work, rather than from the local MDBList sync cache, since list contents aren't synced ahead of time.
Changelog 3.3.212 [FIX] Most TV Shows menus (Discover charts, Collection, Watchlist, Favorites, Recent Episodes, Search Results, By Actor, On Deck) were rendering with no container content type at all instead of "TV Shows"/"Episodes", causing skins to treat them as generic "Videos" and lose TV-Show-specific view options. This was an unintended side effect of a 3.3.199 workaround for what was believed to be a skin issue hiding fully-watched items - that turned out to actually be Kodi's own per-profile "Watched" filter (Settings/Filter on any TV Shows view), not a skin defect. Proper content-type identification is now restored across all 12 affected menus. Note: "Trakt - Recently Watched Shows", "My Watched Episodes", "Merge - Watched Shows", and "MDBList - Recently Watched Shows" are watched-content by design - if Kodi's Watched filter for TV Shows is set to "Unwatched only", these may now show fewer items; set it to "All" to see everything.
Changelog 3.3.211 [FIX] Background Trakt sync for Episode Ratings could silently un-mark a user's own rating on older episodes once a single star-rating tier (e.g. every episode rated "10") grew past Trakt's new page-size limit - the same root cause as 3.3.210, found while double-checking for any other spot with the identical pattern. Episode Ratings sync now pages through each rating tier completely, so this can no longer happen.
Changelog 3.3.210 [FIX] Background Trakt sync for My Movies/My Shows - Collection, and Watched Movies, could silently mark real collected/watched items as removed for accounts with a large Collection or Watched history, following the same Trakt-side API change noted in 3.3.209. Each sync clears the old status before reapplying it, so a fetch that was silently cut short meant genuinely collected/watched items kept getting un-marked again on every sync. These now page through the complete list the same way Watched Shows already does, so collected/watched status stays accurate regardless of history size.
Changelog 3.3.209 [FIX] My Movies/My Shows - Watchlist could silently show an incomplete list for accounts with a large Watchlist, following a Trakt-side API change (Trakt reduced how many items it returns when a request doesn't specify a page size). Watchlist now explicitly pages through the full list the same way Discover Movies/Shows charts already do, so it always loads completely regardless of size.
Changelog 3.3.208 [NEW] Added Trakt Favorites support for both Movies and TV Shows. Discover Movies/Shows gained a "Most Favorited" chart alongside the existing Trending/Popular/Anticipated charts. My Movies/My Shows gained a "Trakt - Favorites" list, and "Add to Favorites"/"Remove from Favorites" are now available from the right-click Trakt Manager menu. Note: Trakt caps Favorites at 50 items total (movies + shows combined) - adding past the limit shows a clear notification instead of failing silently.
Changelog 3.3.207 [FIX] Hardened 3 more settings the same way 3.3.206 hardened "Enable Trakt": "Enable MDBList Scrobbling", "Enable Trakt Scrobbling", and the Trakt account-notification toggle now all explicitly default to "on" if read before the settings screen has ever been opened, instead of relying solely on the settings screen's declared default. No behavior change for anyone who has already loaded the settings screen once.
Changelog 3.3.206 [FIX] Hardened the new "Enable Trakt" toggle's internal default handling so every code path (menus, background sync, scrobbling) explicitly falls back to "on" if the setting can't be read yet, matching the settings screen's declared default. No behavior change for anyone who has loaded the settings screen at least once; this only affects the narrow window right after upgrading, before that happens.
Changelog 3.3.205 [NEW] Added a dedicated "Enable Trakt" toggle (Settings - Watch Accounts, Trakt section), mirroring "Enable MDBList". Defaults on, so nothing changes unless you switch it off. Turning it off hides all Trakt-sourced menu items (Trakt Recommended, On Deck, My Shows/Movies, in-progress merges), pauses the background Trakt sync, and stops scrobbling and watched-marking - while keeping your Trakt login saved, so turning it back on doesn't require re-authenticating.
Changelog 3.3.204 [CHANGE] MDBList Username now appears at the top of Settings - Watch Accounts - MDBList, immediately followed by the Authenticate button - matching Trakt's layout (Username, then Authenticate, then scrobbling settings, with Revoke at the end). No functional change, display order only.
Changelog 3.3.203 [NEW] Added a dedicated "Enable MDBList Scrobbling" toggle (Settings - Watch Accounts, MDBList section), mirroring "Enable Trakt Scrobbling". MDBList can now stay connected for menus/lists while scrobbling is switched off independently; the start-seconds/minimum-percent sliders now only show while both MDBList and its scrobbling toggle are on.
Changelog 3.3.202 [NEW] MDBList scrobbling now has its own "Start scrobble after seconds" and "Minimum scrobble percentage before marked watched" settings (Settings - Watch Accounts, MDBList section), independent of Trakt's. Previously MDBList silently reused Trakt's values, and those settings were only visible once a Trakt account was also connected.
Changelog 3.3.201 [FIX] "Recommended For You" showed only 1 result instead of the full list. The shared filter behind several show discovery menus ("Recommended For You", "Popular Recent Shows", "Trending Recent Shows", Genres, Networks, Related Shows) incorrectly treated any show Seren hadn't seen before as "fully watched" and hid it. These now correctly show all valid results.
Changelog 3.3.200 [FIX] Trakt watched-episode sync updated for an upstream Trakt API change enforced 2026-07-03: the API stopped returning full episode data on the old request shape, which was silently starving every watched-episode menu of data. Sync now requests the correct data explicitly; no other behaviour changes. [FIX] "Trakt - Collection", "Trakt - Recent Episodes", "Trakt - My Watched Episodes", "Trakt - Recently Watched", and "Trakt - Finish Watching" could render empty, or show only a single item, due to two stacking causes: a "hide watched" filter meant for discovery menus, and the active skin hiding fully-watched entries from any watched-status menu. Both are now bypassed for these menus specifically. [FIX] "MDBList - Recently Watched Movies", "MDBList - Recently Watched Shows", and "Merge - Recently Watched Shows" had the same two issues; fixed identically.
Changelog 3.3.199 [FIX] "Merge - Watched" (Movies/Shows) plus the native "Trakt - My Watched Movies" and "Trakt - Recently Watched Shows" menus could render empty or show only partial results when the "Hide Watched" setting was enabled — these lists exist specifically to show watched content, but were unintentionally filtering it out. All four now explicitly bypass that filter.
Changelog 3.3.198 [FIX] Trakt - Recently Watched Shows menu threw a SQLite "ambiguous column name" error introduced by 3.3.197's Merge-menu changes (the new tmdb_id join on the shows table collided with an unqualified ORDER BY). Query now sorts by the intended column explicitly. Also removed an unused parameter from the Merge-menu dedup helper; no behavior change.
Changelog 3.3.197 [NEW] "Merge - In Progress" and "Merge - Watched" entries added to the top of "My Movies"/"My Shows", showing a deduplicated, chronologically-sorted union of the Trakt and MDBList equivalents. Only shown when both Trakt and MDBList are enabled; existing "Trakt - X"/"MDBList - X" entries are unchanged. Known limitation: if Trakt's scrobbler fails to update on a stop event that MDBList's scrobbler correctly records, the affected item can appear in both Merge lists at once.
Changelog 3.3.196 [FIX] "Mark as Watched (MDBList)" now also clears any stale in-progress entry for that item on MDBList, so it no longer lingers in "MDBList - In Progress" after being marked watched.
Changelog 3.3.195 [CHANGE] In "My Movies"/"My Shows", "MDBList - In Progress ..." now lists before "MDBList - Recently Watched ...", matching the existing Trakt ordering convention where "Trakt - Finish Watching" (in-progress) already leads each menu.
Changelog 3.3.194 [CHANGE] All Trakt-sourced items in "My Movies"/"My Shows" now carry a "Trakt - " label prefix (Collection, Watchlist, My Movie/Show Lists, My Liked Lists, Next Up, Upcoming Episodes, Unfinished Shows in Collection, Recent Episodes, My Watched Episodes), matching the 3.3.193 relocation's existing "Trakt - "/"MDBList - " items for full consistency between the two sources in these merged menus.
Changelog 3.3.193 [CHANGE] MDBList browsing menus relocated: the standalone "MDBList" home entry is removed; its four menus (Recently Watched Movies/Shows, In-Progress Movies/Episodes) now live inside the existing "My Movies"/"My Shows" menus alongside their Trakt equivalents, each labelled with a source prefix ("Trakt - ..." / "MDBList - ...") to tell them apart. "My Movies"/"My Shows" are now shown, and reachable, whenever Trakt is authorized OR MDBList is enabled+authorized (previously Trakt-only); each entry inside is individually gated to its own source so a Trakt-only or MDBList-only user only sees their own items.
Changelog 3.3.192 [NEW] MDBList Phase E — browsing menus: new "MDBList" home entry (shown when MDBList is enabled+authorized) with Recently Watched Movies/Shows and In-Progress Movies/Episodes. Items are sourced from your local MDBList sync data (or, for in-progress, live from MDBList) and resolved to Trakt IDs via Trakt's own ID-lookup search so they render and play through Seren's existing, unmodified Trakt menu and playback pipeline. [FIX] Marking an item watched via the MDBList context-menu action now also writes it to the local MDBList sync tables (previously only the scrobbler did this), matching Phase D's behaviour and closing a gap where such marks were invisible in Seren's own local view.
Changelog 3.3.190 [NEW] MDBList Manager split from Trakt Manager in the context menu: the single shared "Trakt Manager" dialog is now dispatched via two distinct actions (traktManager/mdblistManager), each showing only its own service's rows and its own dialog header ("Trakt manager" vs "MDBList manager"). Requires context.seren 3.0.3+ for the corresponding context-menu entries, which are auto-shown/hidden based on whether Trakt is authorized / MDBList is enabled+authorized in Seren (polled every 5s), ANDed with each item's own manual on/off toggle in context.seren's settings.
Changelog 3.3.189 [NEW] MDBList Phase C — context-menu writes: the existing Trakt Manager context-menu entry now also offers "Mark as Watched (MDBList)", "Mark as Unwatched (MDBList)" and "Clear MDBList Progress" (movies/episodes only) when MDBList is enabled and authorized, pushing status directly to MDBList's sync/watched and scrobble/clear endpoints. Trakt's own options are now shown only when Trakt is authorized (previously unconditional). No changes to context.seren; no local DB mirroring (Phase E will read live/synced state).
Changelog 3.3.141 [NEW] Add script.module.curl_cffi as optional dependency in addon.xml — enables Kodi native C-extension loader to mount the lib/ path, allowing curl_cffi Chrome120 TLS impersonation to initialise correctly in Kodi 22. Falls back gracefully to cloudscraper on platforms where the module is absent.
Changelog 3.3.133 [FIX] OpenInfo-aware watchdog stop: when user presses backspace/stop during playback and Seren was launched from an OpenInfo session (detected via openinfo.watchdog.gen window property), the PlaybackWatchdog now exits its retry loop immediately instead of auto-cycling to the next source up to maxRetries times. Non-OpenInfo sessions and genuine stream errors/stalls are unaffected.
Changelog 3.3.94 [NEW] OpenInfo integration — last-resolved quality memory: on every successful, content-verified resolution, write a tiny per-title record (imdb_id keyed) with quality / debrid_provider / release_title / season+episode / timestamp to addon_data/plugin.video.seren/openinfo_last_resolutions.json. OpenInfo's info dialog (7.0.19+) reads this file and surfaces "Last played: 4K HDR · Real-Debrid" before the user hits play. Self-contained: Seren writes its own data dir, OpenInfo reads cross-addon, Seren has no awareness of OpenInfo. Atomic write (tmp + os.replace), 200-row cap with oldest-first eviction, fully wrapped in try so a cache failure can never affect playback.
Changelog 3.1.29 [BUG] Fix Monitor memory leak: singleton xbmc.Monitor now released in deinit() — prevents "left several classes in memory" warning and object accumulation [BUG] Fix ProviderPerformance _row_to_dict crash: row_factory returns dicts not tuples — unpacking dict keys instead of values caused "invalid literal for int()" on column names [BUG] Fix thumbnail loading storm on version change: clean stale entries from Kodi's Textures13.db where cached files are missing — prevents hundreds of CImageLoader failures that freeze the UI
Changelog 3.1.28 [BUG] Fix EasyDebrid module-level requests.Session: moved to @cached_property instance session matching all other debrid modules — eliminates thread-unsafe shared header mutation [BUG] Fix resolver_window close_callback never invoked: missing parentheses on line 159 — callback was referenced but never called on window close Full codebase audit: 127 files syntax-verified, 101 route targets verified, all cache invalidation paths confirmed

Changleog 2.0.0:
Added Download Manager Complete re-write of Trakt Sync Database Metadata handler introduced and complete re-write of handling of metadata Settings that modify metadata can now be changed on the fly and do not require a rebuild Users can now manually resolve a file from the source select screen Users can now manually cache a specific source from the source select screen Complete re-write of menu handling Introduced globals module to handle global variables for interpreter Implement re-use language invoker setting from Kodi Pre-emptive termination now disabled for background Pre-scrapes and timeout set to max for background scrapes New artwork and custom dialogs Metadata now upadted on the fly when updated item encountered from Trakt Next Up menu now populated from local database Sync has been fleshed out to include even more meta data during cycle Failures to auto resolve now prompt user in case they wish to manually interrupt Items are now able to supply multiple images for any given type for skins that make use of it Support for Python 3 Global thread lock now implemented for required methods (prevents multiple syncs occuring at once and other locks) InputStreamAdaptive support Providers now have the abiity to implement settings Provider packages can now elect to make use of their own background services Provider packages can now offer images for each provider Cache and Sync database items are now pickled Complete re-write of resovler module and consolidated code Kodi 19 support All Debrid implementation now fully featured Sources can now be sorted by filesize low to high for users that wish to do so Forcing widget refresh after playback now optional Zip manager implemented for handling of zip files Skin Manager rework Automated resolving now more reliable OMDB API implemented Feedback provided at scrape if no providers are found Feedback provided at scrape if no debrid providers are setup Debrid account status now visible from Seren settings
